sources.title: Manejo da adubação fosfatada para culturas anuais no Cerrado
sources.why: How a phosphorus result is read: the Mehlich-1 figure means something different at each clay range while the resin figure does not — the correction a clayey class makes to reading a lab report. 3,476 characters.

sources.title: Guia prático para interpretação de resultados de análises de solo
sources.why: A low CEC points to kaolinite rather than to little clay, and in weathered soils most of the CEC comes from organic matter — the heuristic 'clayey means fertile' is what tb_oxidic falsifies. 2,958 characters.

sources.title: Uso de gesso agrícola nos solos do Cerrado
sources.why: A clayey Latossolo stores more water than a sandy one, and roots reach it only where the subsoil's acidity was corrected — liming the plough layer does not. Older than ten years, so research-agent.md §8.3 surfaces its age. 4,916 characters.
